ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-31-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change of a minor and petititoner.

Dept. 514, Judge: Paul H. Alvarado, Clerk: S.Vantree, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840

Petitioner Caron Patricia Webster mother of minors present.
Petitioner are sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minors from Jackson James Webster to Jackson Aron Coates, Maxwell James Webster to Maxwell Aron Coates, Angela Caron Webster to Angela Caron Coates and the name of the petitioner from Caron Patricia Webster to Caron Patricia Coates.

Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
